'''Zeta Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that flew [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE/IN interceptors]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], they took part in a [[Battle of Mylok IV|battle]] against [[Nharwaak]] at [[Mylok IV]].
